acceptance_criteria: Streaming input reduces or explains the absence of a reduction in peak allocation; end-to-end throughput and p99 are compared with the original pipeline.
Submit the implementation and a reproducible command or fixture showing the requested behavior, including one failing case.
self_review_question: When is a larger batch the wrong optimization?

title: Performance engineering project
instructions: Build a performance dossier comparing batching, serialization formats and worker/pool sizes for one representative backend workload.
acceptance_criteria: Use repeated runs with confidence ranges or variability reporting.
Include peak memory, CPU and tail latency alongside throughput.
A proposed optimization identifies its correctness and operational tradeoffs.
self_review_question: Which failure can you reproduce and recover from without manual database edits?

title: Laboratory: Events, projections and semantic versioning
instructions: Implement versioned order events and a projection that resumes from a stored offset.
acceptance_criteria: A crash between projection write and checkpoint cannot double-apply the event.
Submit the implementation and a reproducible command or fixture showing the requested behavior, including one failing case.
self_review_question: Why is a queue not automatically an event store?

title: Independent: Events, projections and semantic versioning
instructions: Add a new event version and rebuild a second projection using only historical fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Historical event fixtures rebuild both projections from zero; schema-version changes preserve the meaning of older records without editing history.

acceptance_criteria: Replay from zero reconstructs the same state as incremental processing.
